summary.text: Jamal Todd top-scored with 77 off 66 balls as OTG reached 258-9, while Henry Cooper took 4 for 50. Michael Sclanders then scored 71 off 100 balls to help ND chase the target with a score of 249-7, despite Ben Lockrose claiming 4 for 50, resulting in a 3-wicket win for Northern Districts.
